# `smelt.au`

**Tier:** `Host` — Available in every runtime, including headless mode.

Nvim-shaped surface aliases for [`smelt.cell`](cell.md). `au.on(name, handler)` is `smelt.cell.subscribe`; `au.fire(name, payload)` is `smelt.cell.set`. Both share the same underlying registry — pick whichever name fits your plugin.
